[size=4][b]📖 What is Scaling Weapons?[/b][/size]
Tired of ditching a cool weapon just because its numbers are too low? [b]Scaling Weapons[/b] transforms the Stardew combat experience by recalculating melee stats based on your actual progression. Whether you’re deep in the Skull Cavern or just hitting Combat Level 10, your weapons grow in power to remain viable and satisfying.
Unlike other mods, Scaling Weapons uses a "recalculation" method rather than permanent stat-stacking, ensuring your save file stays clean and bug-free.

[size=4][b]🚀 New in v1.3.0: The Mastery System[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Weapon XP:[/b] Each individual weapon now gains experience as you use it! 
[*] [b]Level Up:[/b] Weapons gain independent levels, providing a [b]+2% damage bonus[/b] per level (configurable).
[*] [b]Custom Curves:[/b] Fully configurable XP requirements and level-up notifications.
[/list]

[size=4][b]🌟 Core Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic Growth:[/b] Damage scales based on [b]Combat Level, Days Played,[/b] and your deepest [b]Mine Level[/b].
[*] [b]Progression Presets:[/b] Choose your flavor: [i]Vanilla+, Hardcore, Power Fantasy,[/i] or [i]Custom[/i].
[*] [b]Visual Evolution:[/b] Weapons emit a tiered glow as they scale (Green → Blue → Purple → Gold).
[*] [b]Biome Multipliers:[/b] Context-aware damage boosts for the Mines, Skull Cavern, and Volcano.
[*] [b]Smart Balancing:[/b] Soft-cap diminishing returns prevent you from becoming "too" broken (unless you enable [b]Infinite Mode[/b]!).
[*] [b]Advanced HUD:[/b] A detailed overlay showing DPS, Weapon Level, and XP progress.
[/list]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration (GMCM Support)[/b][/size]
Full integration with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] allows you to tweak:
[list]
[*] [b]Stat Scaling:[/b] Toggle scaling for Crit Chance, Crit Power, and Knockback.
[*] [b]Multipliers:[/b] Fine-tune Sword, Dagger, and Club performance separately.
[*] [b]Exclusions:[/b] Blacklist specific IDs or exclude Galaxy/Infinity weapons to maintain end-game rarity.
[*] [b]Luck Variance:[/b] Add a layer of RNG where your daily luck influences your damage swing.
[/list]

[size=4][b]🛠️ Installation & Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Requires:[/b] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/url] and [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[*] [b]Optional:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Highly Recommended).
[/list]
[b]How to Install:[/b]
1. Download the latest ZIP.
2. Extract the [i]ScalingWeapons[/i] folder into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.
3. Launch the game and start swinging!

[size=4][b]💻 Console Commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [code]sw_refresh[/code] — Force-apply scaling to current inventory.
[*] [code]sw_debug hud[/code] — Toggles the detailed stats overlay.
[*] [code]sw_debug formula[/code] — Shows the exact math behind your current damage.
[*] [code]sw_rebase[/code] — Resets stored base stats to your weapon's current values.
[/list]

[i]Building a combat overhaul? Scaling Weapons includes a [b]Public API[/b] for modders to ensure compatibility with custom weapon types and mechanics.[/i]
